LESSON: CONDITIONS FOR SWALAH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Conditions for Swalah
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Conditions for Swalah under Strand 1. It is aligned with the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD) CBC design.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. mention the conditions for swalah and write them in their notebook,

2. discuss the conditions for swalah and present in class,

3. demonstrate some of the conditions for swalah such as wudhu, appropriate dress code, individually,

4. demonstrate appropriate use of digital devices/direction of the sun in identifying direction of Qibla, individually/in pairs/groups,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. mention the conditions for swalah and write them in their notebook,
2. discuss the conditions for swalah and present in class,
3. demonstrate some of the conditions for swalah such as wudhu, appropriate dress code, individually,
4. demonstrate appropriate use of digital devices/direction of the sun in identifying direction of Qibla, individually/in pairs/groups,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Conditions for Swalah together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology is enhanced as learners demonstrate appropriate use of digital

devices in identifying direction of Qibla.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of interpretation and inference is enhanced as learners demonstrate

appropriate use of digital devices/direction of the sun in identifying direction of Qibla, individually/in pairs/groups

• Self-efficacy: the skill of effective communication is enhanced as learners demonstrate some of the conditions for swalah

such as wudhu, appropriate dress code, individually.
